description: Land Acquisition - Palligoda and Ovitigala, Matugama D/S Division, Kalutara District
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. The document is explicitly labeled "PART III - LANDS" and "Land Acquisition Notices," making it a clear example of land-related administrative matters that fall under Type 4 (Land Gazettes).
